name: Alex Morgan

resumeText: Alex Morgan is a Solutions Architect at NovaGrid Consulting with eight years of experience. He has worked across cloud architecture, microservices, and cost optimization for greenfield platforms, building a generalist architecture profile. He has no enterprise integration experience, and positions himself as a greenfield and modernization-focused architect.
